tip: when upgrading, reuse the last release's values and merge in any overrides from the command line via --set and -f. If '--reset-values' is specified, this is ignored

option.name: --rollback-on-failure
tip: if set, Helm will rollback the upgrade to previous success release upon failure. The --wait flag will be defaulted to "watcher" if --rollback-on-failure is set

option.name: --server-side
tip: must be "true", "false" or "auto". Object updates run in the server instead of the client ("auto" defaults the value from the previous chart release's method) (default "auto")

option.name: --set

option.name: --set-file

option.name: --set-json

option.name: --set-literal

option.name: --set-string

option.name: --skip-crds

option.name: --skip-schema-validation

option.name: --take-ownership
tip: if set, upgrade will ignore the check for helm annotations and take ownership of the existing resources

option.name: --timeout

option.name: --username

option.name: --values

option.name: --version

option.name: --wait
tip: WaitStrategy[=watcher]                wait until resources are ready (up to --timeout). Use '--wait' alone for 'watcher' strategy, or specify one of: 'watcher', 'hookOnly', 'legacy'. Default when flag is omitted: 'hookOnly'. (default hookOnly)

option.name: --wait-for-jobs
tip: if set and --wait enabled, will wait until all Jobs have been completed before marking the release as successful. It will wait for as long as --timeout
